summary: Frontend-only validation of Function A (Ajouter un plan in QuoteEditor) and Function D (i18n of Nav dropdowns). Both features pass 100%. Function B (Vidéo → devis) was skipped per request.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Visual Editor injects span with style display:contents inside <option> for dynamically rendered options (VAT_RATES, UNITS, STATUSES, LANGS). Non-blocking but pollutes console with hydration errors.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate console hydration warning about <span> inside <option> (comes from visual-editor instrumentation, not from app code itself, but appears on every native <select> render).
critical_code_review_comments: Function A upload works end-to-end: POST /takeoffs/upload → nav /plan?open=<id>&auto=1 → PlanTakeoff pendingAuto effect fires analyzePlanFull(). When plan is not calibrated, backend/front correctly displays 'Calibrez d'abord le plan…' — expected guardrail.

i18n NAV_TRANSLATIONS is complete and consistent for fr/en/pt/es/it/de/ar. All required PT and EN labels validated verbatim (Faturas, Autos de medição, Acompanhamento de obra, Catálogo de preços, Espaço empresa, Invoices, Progress billing, Site tracking).

Small residual FR-only strings inside Pro dropdown items not covered by keys: 'Permis de construire' (hint on Études PC) is not translated in EN/PT (Estudos de licença displayed as label, but the hint tooltip 'Permis de construire' remains FR). Very minor — only visible as suffix text.
seed_data_creation: Created a valid 800x600 PNG at /tmp/test_plan.png via PIL for upload test (a 100x100 solid-color PNG was rejected by process_upload → 422).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Function A: data-testids editor-add-plan-btn / editor-video-btn / editor-add-plan-input all present. Input accept='image/*,application/pdf,.dxf'. Upload → /plan?open=<id>&auto=1 works; automatic analysis is triggered (blocked by 'calibration required' on uncalibrated plans, which is expected). Function D: LangToggle is a native <select data-testid='lang-toggle'>; use select_option('fr'|'en'|'pt'). All Espace Pro / Découvrir dropdown items translated in FR/EN/PT/ES/IT/DE/AR via NAV_TRANSLATIONS in I18nContext.jsx.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial 422 on upload during first run was caused by using a synthetic tiny PNG that process_upload could not decode; using a real PNG (PIL-generated) works fine and is the correct testing approach.
